thread:
Nadia Park: Dropping a quick mock for the autoscale row in narrow layouts. Qs: where to surface the burst hint and how to mark pool priority without breaking the row? Screenshot: https://redwood.design/snap/compact-boost.png

Omar Ruiz: Inline hint next to the burst toggle would be most discoverable. Use a subtle pill 'Burst — temporary capacity' not a long sentence.

Sofia M.: Agree. Make the pill focusable and reachable before the pool selector in DOM order so keyboard users find it.

Nadia Park: Good call. If we reflow the DOM, will tests break? ux-bot any notes?

ux-bot: Note: reordering controls can affect E2E queries targeting visible text. Add role-based selectors in tests, e.g., cy.findByRole('switch', {name: /burst/i}). Also ensure aria-describedby on the burst switch points to the pill content.

Omar Ruiz: For pool priority, replace colored star with an outlined badge + sr-only text 'Priority pool'. Keeps visuals while preserving contrast.

Sofia M.: Microcopy: change "Latency SLO" to "Latency target (95th)" and add small hint "lower is better". People confuse SLO vs SLA.

Nadia Park: Steppers: enlarge tap targets to 44px and add aria-labels like 'increase min'/'decrease max'. Also support shift+click to jump by 5 for power users.

ux-bot: Accessibility checklist: pill contrast >= 4.5:1, focus visible, popupless help when possible, aria-live polite for any ephemeral burst banners.

Omar Ruiz: Tom's suggested burst tooltip copy works: 'Burst temporarily adds GPU capacity for short spikes. Not guaranteed — subject to pool availability.'

Sofia M.: Action items: 1) Move burst pill inline and shorten copy (Nadia). 2) Reorder DOM so pill is before pool picker and add aria-describedby (Omar). 3) Update pool badge to outlined + sr-only (Omar). 4) Update labels and hints (Sofia). 5) Increase stepper hit area and add keyboard shortcuts (Nadia). 6) Run ux-bot checks on PR.

Nadia Park: Will push a small prototype today and tag everyone.
